title: United States at risk of losing measles elimination status due to ongoing outbreaks
summary: The United States faces potential loss of its measles elimination status following recent outbreaks. A WHO regional committee is expected to decide this week whether the U.S. retains the status it achieved in 2000.
takeaways: At least 8 measles deaths reported in 2026
Decision expected from Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) committee this week
Loss of status previously described as unavoidable consequence of transmission patterns

title: Preventive Care Panel Members Hold Significant Pharma and Medical Practice Financial Interests
summary: Federal filings reveal that US Preventive Services Task Force panelists hold substantial conflicts of interest including pharma stocks and private practices, despite ethics waivers.

title: MDCalc Launches CrossCover Tool to Help Doctors Verify AI Medical Chatbot Answers
summary: MDCalc introduces CrossCover, a verification tool designed to increase clinician confidence in generative AI medical reference systems.

title: Healthcare Providers Sue Employers Over Out-of-Network Medical Bill Disputes
summary: Medical providers increasingly pursue legal action against employers, claiming responsibility for out-of-network bills insurers have delayed or underpaid.

title: Democrats investigate the president of the United States' drug pricing agreements
summary: Incoming Democratic committee chairs are pursuing an investigation into drug pricing agreements between pharmaceutical companies and the president of the United States administration.

title: Anthropic CEO forecasts AI breakthroughs will eliminate cancer and Alzheimer's within 10 years
summary: Anthropic's CEO claimed that artificial intelligence will achieve medical breakthroughs leading to cures for cancer and Alzheimer's disease within a decade.

title: Low-Income Parents Face Food Insecurity When Children Refuse Nutritious Options
summary: Health experts highlight the economic burden families face when children's food selectivity requires purchasing alternative items they can afford to waste.
